title: Constant-word composition is ordinary completed-ring composition after scalar restriction
statement: Supply operations o and a normalized Realizations r. Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a field k in which ell is a unit, separated finite-type k-morphisms X -> Y -> Z of finite-type k-schemes, and a compatible compactification triangle [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the normalized ringed models, open comparisons and proper/open package of r [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Let K be integral constructible, with finite Tor amplitude; require F_f K also to have finite Tor amplitude, and the three ordinary open outputs J_f K, J_g F_f K, J_h K to be integral constructible [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. For the independently constructed ordinaryComparison [def-sf-integral-ordinary-compactification-composition] and the normalized constantComparison [def-sf-integral-compactification-comparison-data], H(ordinaryComparison_K)=constantComparison_K. The open adjunction presentations in the constant comparison are arbitrary presentations of the specified functors. This equality concerns actual constant-coordinate morphisms before finite evaluation; no semilinear system, its counit, or completedComparison occurs in the conclusion.

source.place: Step 5; agent-formulated comparison obligation implementing the indicated portion of the integral compactification bridge proof, with Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941 and more-etale.tex Tags 0F7B--0F7D.

proof.text: For the proper letter use the normalized counit-tensor comparison; for the open letter use reduction of the completion unit and its inverse reconstructed unit. After scalar restriction these are the generator q comparisons used by wordComparison, not arbitrary isomorphisms. Apply the two calculations to each of cf, cg and cfg. The stated finite-Tor and open-constructibility hypotheses make the required generator comparisons invertible.

Apply the recursive q formula for the concatenated word. It identifies compositeWordComparison with the two single-word comparisons and their intermediate completion counit. All quotient transitions are the specified ones; no equality is deduced from conservativity.

Coefficient restriction preserves the inverse-image square, units and counits defining the normalized proper/open mate. Mate pasting identifies constantBeta with the restriction of the existing completedShriekIntegralA. It also identifies the proper and open compositors and the equality transports t.i_q and t.p_g. Substitute in constantComparison and cancel the three published compact-support realizations to obtain H(ordinaryComparison)=constantComparison. Identity letters use the same triangles; empty opens and zero inputs give the unique zero morphism.

proof_origin.place: Step 5; comparison of the independently specified normalizations, not a theorem asserted verbatim in Stacks.

theorem constantOrdinaryCompactificationComparison
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {o : IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E}
    (r : Realizations l E D o) (t : Compactification.Triangle f g)
    [QuasiCompact t.cf.i] [QuasiCompact t.cg.i] [QuasiCompact t.q]
    (af : sfCbcModelExtension t.cf.i (constantRing l E) ⊣
      (sfCbcMorphism t.cf.i).modulePull (ULift.{u + 1} (constantRing l E)))
    (ag : sfCbcModelExtension t.cg.i (constantRing l E) ⊣
      (sfCbcMorphism t.cg.i).modulePull (ULift.{u + 1} (constantRing l E)))
    (ah : sfCbcModelExtension t.cfg.i (constantRing l E) ⊣
      (sfCbcMorphism t.cfg.i).modulePull (ULift.{u + 1} (constantRing l E)))
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (_hK : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X K.obj)
    (_hF : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E Y
      ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l k hl t.cf E).obj K).obj)
    (_hf : sfIntegralConstructible l E t.cf.Z ((ringedOpen l E t.cf.i).obj K.obj))
    (_hg : sfIntegralConstructible l E t.cg.Z ((ringedOpen l E t.cg.i).obj
      ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l k hl t.cf E).obj K).obj))
    (_hh : sfIntegralConstructible l E t.cfg.Z ((ringedOpen l E t.cfg.i).obj K.obj)) :
    (H l E Z).map ((ordinaryComparison l E k hl r t).app K) =
      constantComparison l E k hl t af ag ah K
